title: THE HIGH COST OF INCIVILITY: QUANTIFYING INTERACTION INEFFICIENCY VIA MULTI-AGENT MONTE CARLO SIMULATIONS
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of 'incivility' and 'toxic behavior'—which are moral/behavioral constructs—on system efficiency. Additionally, the experimental data and topics for the simulations include a specific 'Religion' domain and moral/ethical propositions (e.g., hate speech, suicide rights, and abortion-related topics under 'CMV' and 'Philosophy' categories).
